newsitem.title: USA: Rhone, Jagotec drop suit vs Andrx.
newsitem.headline: Rhone, Jagotec drop suit vs Andrx.

text.p: Andrx Corp Wednesday said Rhone-Poulenc Rorer Pharmaceuticals Inc and Jagotec AG had agreed to drop their patent infringement lawsuit against Andrx.
The suit, filed last May, alleged that Andrx's controlled-release generic formulation infringed a U.S. patent that covers RPR's Dilacor XR(R) product, Andrx said.
Andrx submitted an Abbreviated New Drug Application to the U.S. Food and Drug Administration in late 1995 for its controlled-release product, which is bioequivalent to Dilacor XR(R).
The RPR-Jagotec suit had the legal effect of preventing the FDA from approving Andrx's product for marketing for a period of up to 30 months.
Andrx said the parties have signed a settlement agreement that provides for the dismissal, without prejudice, of all claims and counterclaims in the lawsuit.
